description: This file defines the UserProfileLoader interface within the package 'com.romraider.logger.ecu.profile'. It declares a constant for the backup profile path and a method to load a user profile from a specified file path.

classes.name: UserProfileLoader
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for loading user profiles, including a constant path for profile backups.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Method that takes a file path as input and returns a UserProfile object representing the loaded profile.
